scope: Requirements for future implementation, not completed evidence

cases.criterion: Existing Git/files inspected; changes preserved; correct project scope and bundle import mapping recorded.
Actual target capabilities or unknowns recorded without secrets; local versions selected independently of missing credentials.
Documented local setup starts/restarts and can be recreated without production secrets.
Theme activates with no presentation plugins; PHP/debug checks pass; standard WP hooks work.
First import creates expected draft Pages without publishing or touching unrelated content.
Rerun is idempotent; unmarked slug and edited-page conflicts are refused with a diff.
Home links to seven actual Pages; long labels and header/footer work with keyboard and no JS.
All seven records render editable text, three benefits, requirements, quick start and correct release-preview states.
Every selected asset slot maps to the exact allowlisted owner source; no preliminary tool-repository imagery or generated artwork is used.
Support Pages and genuine HTTP 404 use correct templates; canonical route set is consistent.
Owner-style edits survive editor reload, theme update and seed plan; home cards remain consistent.
Unique titles, descriptions, canonical/social fields and core sitemap behavior verified; no duplicate metadata.
320–1440px, keyboard, 200% zoom, reduced motion and no-JS checks pass with screenshots.
Metadata saves are authorized/sanitized; no debug errors or secret paths in runtime package.
Signed-out network inspection finds no unexpected external scripts/fonts/trackers; actual host behavior documented separately.
ZIP has one theme root and only runtime/public files; checksum produced; exact ZIP installed on disposable WordPress.
Content/media initialization is complete and distinct from theme updates; no stale database overwrite.
Database, uploads and code restore on disposable instance reproduces representative page/image.
Actual hosting access/private preview verified; signed-out access protection and HTTPS tested; missing access remains blocked.
Actual supplied source dimensions and layout boxes measured in home/pilot screenshots; layouts accommodate completed artwork without new creative requests.
Pilot bytes, source lineage, hashes, separate rights facts and mechanical derivatives inspected; existing owner design approval recorded truthfully.
Pilot desktop/mobile framing visually checked, all important faces/props preserved; any actual creative issue flagged. Routine integration uses existing approval.
All seven character/avatar identities and crops correct on mobile/desktop; editable wording preserved.
All 47 visual inputs accounted for and all 33 selected website slots verified, including eight social previews, icons/favicon and both backgrounds; ancillary usage recorded.
Responsive variants, image priorities, alpha edges, CLS and measured transfer budgets reviewed with final art.
Seven public stable tag records resolved to actual commits; each advertised runtime ZIP downloaded and checksum verified.
Final copy/requirements match those releases; exact download/documentation links work signed out.
Owner-supplied public/contact details and actual privacy facts reviewed; no invented address or unresolved public TODO.
Actual editor/image/link/backup maintenance guide delivered; content wording approval recorded.
Exact final candidate installs privately with approved content/assets; final route/layout/network/performance checks pass.
Backup/rollback evidence and concrete planned public actions prepared; current candidate hash recorded.
Launch authorization exists; exact reviewed candidate deployed to confirmed target with backup; unrelated data/services preserved.
Apex HTTPS/www, all Pages, 404, downloads, art/social assets and production indexing verified live after cache purge.
If failure occurred, rollback outcome recorded; live completion remains false until retested successfully.
Live/deployed/local/remote commits agree; public website v1.0.0 source tag/release, checksummed artifacts, clean signed-out clone, owner guide and all seven cleanup outcomes verified.
Actual owner/repository verified; intended website repository is public, source is license-marked and no private history/content exposed.
Passing checkpoints are committed and pushed with actual remote commit evidence; normal protections respected and auth/network blockers explicit.
All 47 exact visual filenames/aliases reconciled; real PNG/ICO metadata/hashes and visual identity inspected; reference text reviewed.
Original inputs come only from the two owner project folders; no tool-repository fallback/hotlink/reference use; derivative provenance and private-master exclusion verified.
All seven actual default branches/commits inspected; candidates classified with reference evidence and protected runtime/shared files recorded, or verified no-candidates outcomes.
Only confirmed obsolete website-only paths/direct stale references removed through narrow checked commits/PRs; tool runtime/icons/releases/history unchanged.
Actual default branches rechecked after merge, stale links gone and protected assets intact; each repo has merged/no-candidates evidence or an explicit unresolved blocker.
GPL-2.0-or-later code/docs and truthful separate asset/font/dependency notices exist; implementation CI checks actual theme/import/package behavior.
Clean signed-out public clone reconstructs the candidate theme/content/media from committed public sources/derivatives without private masters or credentials.
